preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 2 and 500.
The number of roads m must be between 0 and n*(n-1)/2.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n and 1 <= yi <= n and xi != yi and 1 <= li <= 10**6 for xi, yi, li in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two distinct cities within the range and have a positive length.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n*(n-1)/2 integers representing the counts of roads on shortest paths.
Each count in the output must be a non-negative integer.
At least one count in the output must be greater than zero if there are any paths between cities.
